rules.behavior: BitmapSurfaceLoader uses System.Drawing.Bitmap at native pixel size; upper-left RGB is the source color key. Picture chooses four seasons and day/night. A season day override without night builds its own night; an unspecified season inherits spring day and spring night. getNightOverride checks only the FIRST override child; do not silently reinterpret later night siblings. Automatic night divides RGB components by 4, except (8,0,0)->(255,8,8), (0,8,0)->(252,243,148), (0,0,8)->(255,227,99), also transforming the key. Native RGB555/565 quantization differs from RGB888: retain as fidelity decision, not arbitrary browser recoloring. ExAV replaces the old DirectDraw.AlphaBlend DLL with DirectXWrapper.NightImageBuilder in lib/DirectXWraper/AlphaBlender.cpp; the old native paths are absent. The 32-bit native branch preserves the high byte and quarters masked low RGB bytes. Native 16-bit mode detection compares the red mask three times: do not claim these branches were runtime-validated.

rules.behavior: Source rectangle origin/size and destination anchor offset are distinct. draw places top-left at projected voxel point minus offset; preserve transparent margins. Zero height produces NullSprite. 3D splits roof/front/edge slices, clips negative roof origins, fills invisible cells with NullSprite; use pinned load3D body as the complete algorithm. Invisible sprite does not mean unoccupied voxel. Default loader ID spriteLoader:default.

differences.disposition: Retain all declarations. Auto-development consumes direct entries; player reachability is a P0-03 source question, not a reason to exclude content or claim a working menu.

differences.finding: 75 manifest DLL paths are absent, but every explicit qualified type binds to retained source and compile membership. PluginUtil also has recursive filename fallback.
differences.disposition: Resolve research edges via qualified types and projects, retaining original missing paths. No DLL loaded, compiled or declared runtime-ready. Selected-solution evidence is recorded independently.

differences.finding: Five missing embedded/content project edges remain: three in old core project, plus Straight.bmp in both TAT projects. Two further old-core Compile gaps remain in discovery.
differences.disposition: Retain diagnostics. TAT ImageStream payload and both GIF bytes match the historical pixel derivation, despite changed resx file hash; reuse that narrow image result. No ExAV project file is corrected by this review.

differences.finding: ExAV moves native rendering into DirectXWraper; DirectSprite.offset remains recursive, ColorMappedSprite documents night collision limitations, and native 16-bit format detection tests the red mask repeatedly.
differences.disposition: Use ExAV wrapper source, never historical native dependency paths. P2/P4 select and verify pixel behavior and record defect adaptations; no runtime or visual acceptance claimed.

differences.finding: Structure prices/entity values become Int64; variable-height pricePerArea changes to footprint price. Train seatedcapacity is separate from capacity.
differences.disposition: Preserve exact numeric data and distinct capacity terms. P0-05/P3/P5/P7 must derive migrations and costs against ExAV; retain prototype protocol/save values until a migration exists.

differences.finding: Half-voxel ownership/costs, bank/economy returned timer handlers, stadium population/audience/counters/timers and TAT Train-dependent stop time differ.
differences.disposition: Contribution ID substitution still differs from placed state. Retain new fields and nested types as P0-05 candidates; source indexing is not a complete CLR save graph or continuation evidence.

differences.finding: Stable distribution notices are under doc/; manifest credits do not establish individual image authorship. A4 and debug manifests remain excluded; VCR is absent.
differences.disposition: Attach stable readme/readme_ftexav/COPYING hashes to every asset. Optional non-LGPL sets remain separate P0-08 inputs and outputs.

differences.finding: Pinned source retains CP932 manifests and SOURTH. Owner-approved working-tree corrections are recorded separately.
differences.disposition: Use UTF-8 and SOUTH when porting under EXAV-ENC-001 / EXAV-DIR-001. Do not substitute dirty checkout files into pinned evidence.
